abilities.name: damp
abilities.effect: Prevents self destruct, explosion, and aftermath from working while the Pokémon is in battle.

kanto.flavorText: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

original-johto.flavorText: When they're in a safe location, they can be seen playfully tangling their tails together.

hoenn.flavorText: By cleverly flicking the fins on its back side to side, it moves in any direction while facing forward. It spits ink to escape if it senses danger.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

updated-johto.flavorText: Its big, developed fins move rapidly, allowing it to swim backward while still facing forward.

original-unova.flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

updated-unova.flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

kalos.flavorText: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: If Horsea senses danger, it will reflexively spray a dense black ink from its mouth and try to escape. This Pokémon swims by cleverly flapping the fin on its back.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: If it senses any danger, it will vigorously spray water or a special type of ink from its mouth.

swsh.flavorText: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.
